credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/mint.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. LOOMING: three tiers of crinkled pairs on a thick square stem, the lead leaf thrust over the foe, a frosted flower spike crowning the head. Gesture: the crown pair folds in over the spike, then flares wide as the spike rears inside a burst of frost sparkles, holds, settles. Sport: 'Chocolate' mint.
